_meta.description: ERPNext Doctype Dependency Graph — Single source of truth for doctype relationships, field requirements, and module memberships. Used by agent to validate company data and determine setup order.

reading_guide.depends_on: These doctypes MUST exist before this doctype can be created
reading_guide.unlocks: Creating this doctype enables these downstream doctypes
reading_guide.required_fields: Fields that MUST be populated for the doctype to be submitted
reading_guide.key_settings: Which ERPNext settings control behavior of this doctype
reading_guide.sme_relevance: Which of the 7 SME niches need this doctype — always/conditional/never

setup_layers.description: Agent must resolve doctypes in this order. Never skip a layer.

Company.notes: First doctype to create. Abbr (e.g., 'ACC' for Acme Corp) is used as prefix for all accounts and warehouses. Cannot be deleted once transactions exist.

signal_in_files: any dated transaction file tells you the fiscal year range
Fiscal Year.notes: India: April 1 to March 31. Must exist before any invoice or journal entry can be posted.

Currency.notes: INR pre-exists in ERPNext. Only create additional currencies for export-import companies.

signal_in_files: unit column: Nos, Kg, Mtr, Ltr, Box, Pcs, Set, Pair, Dozen
UOM.notes: Common SME UOMs: Nos (count), Kg (weight), Mtr (fabric/pipe), Ltr (liquid), Box, Pcs. Detect from item list unit column.

signal_in_files: account names in balance sheet files
Account.notes: ERPNext auto-creates a chart of accounts on Company creation (India = standard Indian COA). Agent should map Tally ledgers to ERPNext accounts. Missing mapping = blocking issue.

Cost Center.sme_relevance: conditional — only if company has multiple departments or branches
Cost Center.notes: SME default: single cost center = Company Name. Only add more if multiple profit centers detected in files.

signal_in_files: multiple sheet tabs named by city/branch

warehouse_types.Stores: Raw materials and purchased goods — always needed

Warehouse.notes: Minimum 1 warehouse. Signal for multiple warehouses: city/branch names appearing as separate columns or sheets in stock files.

Tax Template.notes: For India: detect GST rate from tax column in invoice files. CGST+SGST = intrastate, IGST = interstate. Missing HSN codes = data gap.

Item Group.notes: Organizes items into categories. Detect from 'Category' or 'Type' column in item master file. If absent, use business-type defaults (e.g., Raw Material, Finished Goods, Consumable).

Customer Group.notes: Minimum: Commercial, Individual. Detect from customer type column or infer from GSTIN presence (GSTIN = B2B commercial customer).

signal_in_files: supplier type column in supplier list
Supplier Group.notes: Minimum: Raw Material Supplier, Service Provider, Trader.

Territory.sme_relevance: always — even if just 'India' as default
Territory.notes: For SMEs: India > State hierarchy. Detect states from customer address column.

signal_in_files: multiple rate columns for same item
Price List.sme_relevance: conditional — single price list is default; multiple only if price varies by customer/zone
Price List.notes: Standard setup: 1 Standard Selling + 1 Standard Buying. Signal for multiple: different prices for same item across customer rows, or a 'price type' column.

item_types.Stock Item: Physical goods tracked in inventory — traders and manufacturers
item_types.Non-Stock Item: Services, consumables not tracked — service companies

critical_flags.is_stock_item: Must be true for inventory tracking
critical_flags.has_variants: True if item has size/color variants — garment, hardware niches
critical_flags.has_batch_no: True for food, pharma, items with expiry
critical_flags.has_serial_no: True for electronics, machinery with serial tracking

common_data_gaps: Duplicate item names with different codes
Missing HSN codes (GST compliance failure)
UOM inconsistency (Kg vs KG vs kilogram)
Missing opening stock values
Item variants not split into parent+template structure
Item.notes: Most critical master. Quality of item master determines 80% of migration success. Detect variants by looking for size/color columns in the item list.

signal_in_files: multiple rows for same product with different specs
Item Variant.notes: Only needed when same product exists in multiple sizes/colors. Parent item = template, child items = variants. Do not create individual items for each variant — creates item master chaos.

important_fields.gstin: GST registration — mandatory for B2B India compliance
important_fields.credit_limit: Detected if credit days/limit column in customer list
important_fields.payment_terms: Detected if 'payment days' or 'credit days' column exists
important_fields.customer_primary_address: City/state for territory mapping and IGST/CGST determination

common_data_gaps: Duplicate customer names (Ram Traders vs Ram Traders Pvt Ltd)
Missing GSTIN for B2B customers
Missing addresses — blocks GST state determination
Phone/email missing — blocks communication
Customer.notes: GSTIN presence = B2B customer. Absence = B2C or unregistered dealer. This distinction affects invoice format and GST filing.

common_data_gaps: Missing GSTIN — blocks ITC (Input Tax Credit) claim
Missing payment terms
Bank account details missing for payment processing
Supplier.notes: Missing supplier GSTIN = cannot claim Input Tax Credit. High priority data gap for any India business.

unlocks: auto-population of rate in invoices and orders
Item Price.notes: Without Item Price, every invoice requires manual rate entry. Detect from rate column in item master or from historical invoice rates.

signal_in_files: columns: Component, Qty per Unit, Parent Item
BOM.sme_relevance: conditional — manufacturers only (Garment, Food Processing, Fabrication)

bom_complexity.single_layer: Finished good → raw materials (garment, food) — one level deep
bom_complexity.multi_layer: Finished good → sub-assembly → raw materials (furniture, machinery) — multiple levels
bom_complexity.job_shop: No standard BOM — each job is unique (fabrication, custom engineering)

common_data_gaps: BOM does not exist at all — most common for first-time ERP users
Components listed but quantities not defined
BOM for finished good but not for sub-assemblies (multi-layer only)
Scrap/waste percentage not defined
BOM.notes: If company has NO BOM file — they do not know their material costs. Must be built from scratch via discovery questions. This is the most common critical gap in manufacturing SMEs.

key_settings: Buying Settings → po_required (makes PO mandatory before invoice)
signal_in_files: PO number column in purchase files
Purchase Order.sme_relevance: conditional — micro companies often skip PO and go direct to invoice
Purchase Order.notes: For micro SMEs (< 10 people), PO is often skipped. Set po_required = No initially. Enforce later as process matures.

signal_in_files: delivery date column in order files
Sales Order.sme_relevance: conditional — traders may go direct Sales Invoice; manufacturers need SO → Work Order flow
Sales Order.notes: Job shop manufacturers MUST use SO → Work Order. Traders and service companies can skip SO and invoice directly.

stock_entry_types.Material Receipt: Receiving items without purchase order (opening stock entry)
stock_entry_types.Manufacture: Converting raw materials to finished goods

signal_in_files: stock balance as of date file
Stock Entry.sme_relevance: always — needed for opening stock upload
Stock Entry.notes: Opening stock entry is always required during ERPNext go-live. Detect from 'stock statement' or 'closing stock' file. Quantity + rate (value) both needed.

Stock Reconciliation.sme_relevance: always — used for opening stock if history is messy
Stock Reconciliation.notes: Preferred method for opening stock when company has existing stock but no clear purchase history. Sets both quantity and value in one step.

Purchase Receipt.sme_relevance: conditional — micro companies often skip and go direct to invoice
Purchase Receipt.notes: Separating receipt from invoice enables 3-way matching (PO → GRN → Invoice). SMEs often skip this initially.

Delivery Note.sme_relevance: conditional — manufacturers and distributors need it; service companies never
Delivery Note.notes: Detected by presence of dispatch challan, delivery challan, or LR (lorry receipt) numbers in sales files.

Work Order.notes: For make-to-stock: Work Order is standalone. For make-to-order / job shop: Work Order is linked to Sales Order. If no BOM exists, Work Order cannot be created.

Job Card.sme_relevance: conditional — only for manufacturers who track operations (routing). Garment, food processing with defined process steps
Job Card.notes: Job Cards are optional for simple single-step manufacturing. Only needed if operations/routing exists.

india_gst_requirements.b2b_invoice: GSTIN of customer mandatory, HSN code mandatory, place of supply mandatory
india_gst_requirements.b2c_invoice: No GSTIN needed, HSN mandatory above ₹50k
india_gst_requirements.export_invoice: Special export flag, no GST or zero-rated

common_data_gaps: Missing HSN codes on items
Wrong GST rate applied
Missing customer GSTIN for B2B
Place of supply not set (affects CGST/SGST vs IGST)
Sales Invoice.notes: Most common first transaction type in migration. Historical invoice data is usually the best source of item masters and customer masters.

Purchase Invoice.notes: Supplier GSTIN must be on invoice for ITC claim. Missing supplier GSTIN = lost tax credit = real financial loss for SME.

Payment Entry.notes: Bank statement import is the fastest way to create payment entries. Detect bank account from IFSC/account number columns in payment files.

Journal Entry.sme_relevance: conditional — used for opening balances, debit/credit notes, adjustments
Journal Entry.notes: Used for opening balance entry (accounts receivable, payable, bank balances from Tally). Most common migration use case.

Quotation.sme_relevance: conditional — B2B traders, manufacturers with formal quoting; rarely used by FMCG distributors
Quotation.notes: Job shops and project-based businesses need quotations. FMCG distributors and cash traders typically skip.

key_settings: Stock Settings → auto_indent (auto-create when stock hits reorder level)
Material Request.sme_relevance: conditional — larger SMEs with procurement process; micro companies skip
Material Request.notes: Auto-indent triggered by reorder level on Item. Detect reorder levels from item files with min stock or safety stock column.

Lead.sme_relevance: conditional — only if CRM module is needed; most SMEs start without it
Lead.notes: Skip for first ERPNext implementation. CRM is phase 2 for most SMEs. Priority is transactional modules first.

doctype_dependency_matrix.description: Quick lookup — can doctype X be created if doctype Y is missing?

rules.then_blocked: all financial transactions (invoices, payments, journal entries)
auto-population of rates in transactions (manual entry still possible)
